video_title: Bulls REKAP ® Podcast 🏀 (S2 - EP39): Joe Cowley Grades The 2026 NBA Draft

quotes.speaker: Joe Cowley
quotes.summary_phrase: Joe Cowley on the Bulls' Nick Claxton trade
quotes.excerpt: the Nick Claxton trade the night before the draft, I thought was pretty solid
quotes.quote: The Nick Claxton trade the night before the draft, I thought was pretty solid just because Tiago Splitter has a relationship with Claxton from their days in Brooklyn when he was an assistant head coach.

quotes.speaker: Joe Cowley
quotes.summary_phrase: Joe Cowley on Caleb Wilson as a foundation piece
quotes.excerpt: a tall, rim protector, way more athletic than Claxton, and obviously a piece being looked at
quotes.quote: You get another tall, rim protector, way more athletic than Claxton, and obviously a piece that is being looked at as a foundation piece in Caleb Wilson with pick number four.

quotes.speaker: Joe Cowley
quotes.summary_phrase: Joe Cowley on Dalen Swain's two-way potential
quotes.excerpt: has a chance to be an elite two-way player, has made improvements each year
quotes.quote: Dalen Swain from Texas. Slasher, has a chance to be an elite two-way player, has made improvements each year from two years at Xavier and then his one year at Texas.

quotes.speaker: Joe Cowley
quotes.summary_phrase: Bryson Graham on establishing a Bulls team identity
quotes.excerpt: we're establishing an identity. I think that's really important for this organization

text_blocks.speaker: Joe Cowley
text_blocks.text: Did you feel that that deal and then the two picks instantly establish what you wanted this Bulls culture to be?

text_blocks.speaker: Bryson Graham
text_blocks.text: We're getting there. We're definitely not where we want to be, but we're establishing an identity. I think that's really important for this organization, especially where we're at right now. Both Caleb Wilson and Dalen Swain, they fit the bill. We're not addressing every skill yet. There's a certain mentality and a certain profile in a way that coach Tiago Splitter and myself want to play, and we feel like today was a good layer for that.

quotes.speaker: Joe Cowley
quotes.summary_phrase: Joe Cowley on Jonathan Kuminga's development at Golden State
quotes.excerpt: you're going to grow up real quick when Jimmy Butler, Draymond Green and Stephen Curry are your mentors
quotes.quote: Jonathan Kuminga has some immaturity issues for his age of being a 23, 24-year-old grown man. Guess what? You're going to grow up real quick when Jimmy Butler, Draymond Green and Stephen Curry are your mentors, because they'll punch you. At least two of them will. Two of them will punch you in the face.

quotes.speaker: Joe Cowley
quotes.summary_phrase: Joe Cowley on the Bulls' second-round trade
quotes.excerpt: they drafted Brayden Smith from Purdue, traded him for Cam Jones, former Marquette product
quotes.quote: They drafted Brayden Smith from Purdue, traded him for Cam Jones, former Marquette product with Indiana. Future swap of picks, a little bit of cash, and then with that second pick, I think it was 56th overall, they traded that for cash considerations.

quotes.speaker: Joe Cowley
quotes.summary_phrase: Joe Cowley on OKC's draft strategy
quotes.excerpt: you got your big 7'4" French alien, we've got our big 7'3" Spaniard, Adem Bona
quotes.quote: OKC, the rich get richer. Solid A. They basically said, okay, you got your big 7'4" French alien, we've got our big 7'3" Spaniard, Adem Bona from Michigan. And along with Tim Hardaway, we don't know his future, but now we have three bigs, 7 feet or taller, and we are going to physically try and beat up Wembanyama.

quotes.speaker: Joe Cowley
quotes.summary_phrase: Joe Cowley on the Spurs' draft picks
quotes.excerpt: I see your Adem Bona and I raise you a Jaden Quaintance. And then I raise you a Terrence Reed
quotes.quote: The San Antonio Spurs. I see your Adem Bona and I raise you a Jaden Quaintance. And then I raise you a Terrence Reed. Two more bigs coming to the Spurs. One, if the knee is healthy, Quaintance is a ridiculous elite shot-blocking, athletic pain in the butt where you could actually say, we're going to go with this jumbo lineup where Wembanyama is our four.

quotes.speaker: Joe Cowley
quotes.summary_phrase: Joe Cowley on the Memphis Grizzlies' draft
quotes.excerpt: Cameron Boozer, set it before, could end up being the best player out of this draft class
quotes.quote: The Memphis Grizzlies. When's the last time you said, damn, the Memphis Grizzlies really had a smart day? Cameron Boozer, set it before, could end up being the best player out of this draft class. They go ahead and get Kareem Lopez in the 20s. And then Richie Saunders, that's a sneaky good pick, just kind of a dead-eye shooter out of BYU.

quotes.speaker: Joe Cowley
quotes.summary_phrase: Joe Cowley on the Isaiah Stewart trade
quotes.excerpt: to go get Isaiah Stewart from Detroit and give up three second-round picks
quotes.quote: To go get Isaiah Stewart from Detroit and give up three second-round picks, it almost made me step back and go, wow, Bryson, could you have done that? Isaiah Stewart might not be the perfect mix of what they want from an influential standpoint, because he wants to just punch you in the head. Maybe they don't want that in the locker room with such young guys. Maybe Nick Claxton is a better influence on these young guys, Modas, Caleb Wilson.

quotes.speaker: Joe Cowley
quotes.summary_phrase: Joe Cowley on Indiana's draft grade
quotes.excerpt: it's almost like they made the trade with the Bulls in the second round
quotes.quote: Indiana, D+. It's almost like they made the trade with the Bulls in the second round, they sent Cam Jones out, Brayden Smith. I'm not taking away from what he does. He sees the floor, he's a playmaker, assist guy, can shoot it a little bit. I just don't know where he fits. It feels like he's just another TJ McConnell, poor man's, because we don't know what he's going to be. The secret sauce for Indiana is health. Is Tyrese Haliburton ready to come back? Are all those other guys, Nemhard and Siakam, ready to again make that charge towards the Eastern Conference championship?

quotes.speaker: Joe Cowley
quotes.summary_phrase: Joe Cowley on New Orleans' draft
quotes.excerpt: Jaron Pierre in the second round. I get it, you mortgaged your future last year
quotes.quote: New Orleans. Jaron Pierre in the second round. I get it, you mortgaged your future last year with the Derek Queen deal and you might be patting yourself on the back and saying, all they got was Acean Nu last year and they got Kingston Fleming this year with our pick. I think Kingston Fleming has a chance to be a really nice lead guard for a team that was in the playoffs and really lacked a lead guard. Rumors about trading Zion, rumors about, you know, kind of reshaping this thing and starting to build out of the muck. If Zion gets hurt again, this is a bottom three team.

quotes.speaker: Joe Cowley
quotes.summary_phrase: Joe Cowley on the Houston Rockets' draft
quotes.excerpt: Thorton is a superhuman being, probably one of the nicest guys in the draft
quotes.quote: Houston, D. Thorton is a superhuman being, probably one of the nicest guys in the draft, four-year captain at Ohio State. But what are you, Houston? Two years ago, you were the next big thing that was going to be a dynasty killer. The Fred VanVleet injury was huge. It took away your main guy. But you did nothing. You could have got IO, you could have got Kobe White, you just sat there and said, no, we got enough. And now I don't know what direction you're going. Rumors that you might trade KD. I don't know what you're doing.

quotes.speaker: Joe Cowley
quotes.summary_phrase: Joe Cowley on the Denver Nuggets' draft
quotes.excerpt: I like what they did in the second round. The Bulls were even rumored to be looking
quotes.quote: Denver Nuggets, D-. I like what they did in the second round. The Bulls were even rumored to be looking at Brazil. So I don't have a problem with that pick. What I have a problem is Denver continued, much like Houston, but Denver did it. They were a championship team and we were all saying, this is a future dynasty. Joker's MVP, Aaron Gordon is now a two-way player and a great robin to Joker's Batman. Jamal Murray is not playoff Jimmy, he's playoff Jamal and he's just a different dude come playoff time.

quotes.speaker: Joe Cowley
quotes.summary_phrase: Joe Cowley on Braylen Mullins' draft stock
quotes.excerpt: Braylen Mullins, Yukon superhero freshman, won them the Natty with the shot heard around the Natty
quotes.quote: Braylen Mullins, Yukon superhero freshman, won them the Natty with the shot heard around the Natty. Pure shooter, tall, decided to go back to school. I think he would have probably been 15 to 22. Now he has a chance to be top five, top seven.

quotes.speaker: Joe Cowley
quotes.summary_phrase: Joe Cowley on Jason Crow Jr.'s potential
quotes.excerpt: Jason Crow Jr., be going to Missouri, keep your eye on this kid
quotes.quote: Jason Crow Jr., be going to Missouri, keep your eye on this kid. Showed out in the McDonald's game. Kind of a combo guard, could play point, could play off guard, which a couple of these next guys can. You know who might need that? The Bulls.

quotes.speaker: Joe Cowley
quotes.summary_phrase: Joe Cowley on Caleb Holt's draft potential
quotes.excerpt: Caleb Holt number three. Love Caleb Holt. Was actually thinking of Caleb Holt number two
quotes.quote: Caleb Holt number three. Love Caleb Holt. Was actually thinking of Caleb Holt number two. He was co-MVP of the McDonald's game. He'll be at Arizona, combo guard, can shoot it, has a little dog to him, a lot of things I like about him.

quotes.speaker: Joe Cowley
quotes.summary_phrase: Joe Cowley on Jordan Smith Jr.'s draft potential
quotes.excerpt: Jordan Smith Jr., Cala Pari got another one, he will be at Arkansas
quotes.quote: Jordan Smith Jr., Cala Pari got another one, he will be at Arkansas. There's some back and forth with is it Holt, is it Smith Jr., is it the number one guy? Number one guy as of right now has it pretty much locked in, we shall see. He is going to Kansas, Tyran Stokes. The only non-guard of the last four guys, of the high school or of the incoming freshman.
